items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser suits oily skin and keeps the routine simple.
A single night-time gel aimed at the occasional spots and uneven texture you mentioned.
A light barrier moisturizer helps offset dryness from the gel and supports your moisture score.
A mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside the night gel, and it helps keep marks from darkening on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and night, apply SPF in the morning, and use a pea-sized amount of the gel at night every second night at first, followed by moisturizer. I kept this to four steps so it stays easy to follow, and if spots become painful, deep or leave marks, a dermatologist is the better person to ask.
